cells.normalized_text: While a Void Buff (Devour, Invisibility, or Overshield) is active: Melee and Sword Hits inflict Weaken for 6 seconds. Checks on-hit, instead of snapshotting on-usage. On Melee or Sword Kill while a Void Buff is active: Triggers a Weakening Burst, inflicting Weaken to enemies within 4 meters for 6 seconds.

sources.supports: Void elemental buff qualifies melee and Sword hits for Weaken and final blows for a weakening burst. Qualitative agreement only: no independent duration, radius, same-kill timing or current availability proof.

implementation.qualification: Artifact source scoped to holder; matching owner and melee_damage OR (weapon_damage AND sword). event_buffs_available plus historical source_owner Devour/Invisibility/Void Overshield tags at actual damage boundary, not launch-time qualification or subsequent live reaction state.
implementation.hit: Known nonlethal hit invokes shared Weaken with original event attribution; status authorization is independent of damage immunity.
implementation.kill: Confirmed kill with observed death feet position queries current non-allied living targets within4m, excluding owner and original victim. Each target independently invokes shared status, with no extra blast damage.
implementation.weaken: Both combatant and actual-player durations6s; respective ordinary strengths.15/.075 delta; existing shared damage/movement/lifecycle policies retained.
implementation.history: Separate bounded damage_id/death_id sets per artifact source; valid new events refresh cleanup horizon and schedule individual forgetting. No gameplay cooldown or loop-depth limit.
implementation.lifecycle: Weapon stow keeps eligibility; artifact source detach cancels future reactions and clears private receipt state, retaining already applied target Weaken.
implementation.unknown: Unknown damage commits no hit/kill reactions and is never retried; unknown status authorization creates no status. Unavailable historical attacker observation or death position does not fall back to current state.

remaining: 实际命中和击杀已连接物理投射物、支付后的近战技能账户及真实武器容器，但攻击分类由显式合成定义提供；原版native_damage不会自动冒充近战或剑，完整剑轻重击/能量/格挡、各技能和派生伤害信用仍未实现或校准。
Void Overshield复用实际共享盾池；Devour和Invisibility目前仅为资格标签夹具，不代表完整吞噬治疗/回能或隐身行为。正式神器单选来源、子职业/装备装配和当前赛季可用性仍未完成。
历史资格取实际伤害边界：同一hit随后获得/移除Buff不改写kill资格。这是明确的事件时序政策，原作对应反应顺序仍需实测。死亡目标不追加Weaken，致死命中走范围分支；与要求被削弱目标击杀的其他词条交互未校准。
已知IMMUNE命中仍可独立请求状态授权，DENIED不施加；CANCELLED/FAILED不产生hit。原作所有免疫、格挡、图腾救活和特殊技能资格需逐项校准，不能由合成测试推断全部原作行为。
四米按历史死者脚底位置与当前目标脚底球形距离、not_allied、无视线过滤查询；范围锚点、敌我分类、障碍和全部跨来源刷新/首信用政策仍需原作校准。目标拒绝与来源卸下政策为显式Chorus选择。
receipt_seconds是宿主必填的有限回执去重期限，不是效果冷却或连锁上限；一秒夹具只证明期限内幂等，期限外回执重放不保证去重。重复神器来源须由正式装配层约束。
测试10伤害、20m/s、零重力、1秒飞行、0.15秒射击间隔、弹量/0.2秒换弹、两秒资格标记和立即支付的近战均为合成参数，不作D2武器/技能数值。
完整生产规则包、HUD/素材绑定、剑与近战动画、物理世界跨重启恢复，以及共享Weaken的战员AI准确性/完整空中移动仍未完成。
